messages:
Dylan: Quick check — RCA-901 action list attached. Can owners confirm they can hit current due dates or need staggered deadlines? We have infra migration on 2025-05-09 that blocks some follow-ups. Pinged below.

Sofia: I can take infra rollforward test (action 2). 2025-05-08 is tight; prefer 2025-05-12. Will need Marcus' migration window to be confirmed.

Marcus: Migration window is locked 2025-05-09 -> 2025-05-11. We can support a 2025-05-12 validation only if rollback hooks and canary are in place. @Sofia can you add a rollback plan entry?

Priya: I'm owner for model-compatibility tests (action 3). On track for 2025-05-07. Will post results to #eng-ml and link here.

Casey: Docs update (action 1) — can ship 2025-05-06. small ask: need the config snippet from Marcus to include in the example.

infra-bot: Scheduled maintenance notice — 2025-05-09 02:00-06:00 UTC (affects a subset of infra nodes).

Dylan: OK adjust plan: Casey 2025-05-06, Priya 2025-05-07, Sofia 2025-05-12. Marcus please confirm rollback plan or canary steps so Sofia can validate.

Marcus: Canary plan yes — will post steps and a gist by EOD 2025-05-05. Rollback hooks PR coming (infra repo).

Sofia: Ack. Will validate canary during 2025-05-11 window and finalize 2025-05-12. If canary fails, we will hold cutover.

Casey: Draft PR created: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/998 — requesting review from @Dylan and @Priya. I added a short note about the migration impact for CS.

Priya: quick Q — which snapshot should we use for compatibility runs? prod-snap-2025-04-30 or latest-dev?

Dylan: Use prod-snap-2025-04-30 to mirror customer data. Also action owners please add due date to the RCA tracking sheet (linked in the doc).

Priya: Added due date and link to results.

Marcus: Uploading rollback hooks to infra repo, PR #412 is open. ETA EOD 2025-05-04.

Dylan: Thanks. @Sofia can you confirm whether 2025-05-12 will unblock the dependent customer cutover? If yes, we'll mark INC-901 as 'pending final verification' and plan to close after your sign-off.

Sofia: Yes — 2025-05-12 unblocks cutover for two customers (ACME & Nova). I will post the final verification checklist after the canary.

Casey: :thumbsup: I'll do a final docs pass and add a short CS summary after Sofia's verification.

Dylan: Good. I'll update RCA-901 checklist and set a short async check-in on 2025-05-06. If anything slips, flag ASAP in this thread.

```
RCA-901 checklist:
- [ ] Docs PR (Casey) - due 2025-05-06
- [ ] Model tests (Priya) - due 2025-05-07
- [ ] Rollback hooks (Marcus) - due 2025-05-04
- [ ] Canary validation (Sofia) - window 2025-05-11
- [ ] Final cutover validation (Sofia) - 2025-05-12
```

Marcus: I'll post the gist with canary commands and a simple smoke script by EOD 2025-05-05.

Sofia: Will run the smoke script in the canary window and report status here.

Dylan: Perfect — thanks everyone. I'll lock the updated due dates in the tracker and message any downstream stakeholders.
